setup_fastcsp_logger: create a FastCSP logger with configurable file and console output handlers and log level
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP project header banner with optional restart info and stage list to the logger
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary as pretty-printed JSON to the FastCSP logger for readability
get_fastcsp_logger: get or create a FastCSP logger from a config dictionary with automatic log file path resolution
log_error: log an exception with its type and full traceback to the FastCSP logger in a standardized format
